assets_folder_path_normalized.name: assets_folder_path_normalized
assets_folder_path_normalized.value:
folder_path = ''
        or (length(folder_path) <= 1024
            and folder_path = normalize(folder_path, NFC)
            and folder_path ~ '^/([ -~]+/)*$'
            and folder_path !~ '(^|/)[[:space:]]*\.\.[[:space:]]*(/|$)'
            and folder_path !~ '(^|/)[[:space:]]*\.[[:space:]]*(/|$)'
            and folder_path !~ '(^|/)[[:space:]]'
            and folder_path !~ '[[:space:]](/|$)'
            and folder_path !~ '%[0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f]')

permission_grants_states_something.name: permission_grants_states_something
permission_grants_states_something.value: is_deny or role is not null

permission_grants_window_ordered.name: permission_grants_window_ordered
permission_grants_window_ordered.value: starts_at is null or ends_at is null or starts_at < ends_at

snapshot_entries_relative_path_safe.name: snapshot_entries_relative_path_safe
snapshot_entries_relative_path_safe.value:
relative_path <> ''
        and length(relative_path) <= 1024
        and relative_path = normalize(relative_path, NFC)
        and relative_path ~ '^[ -~]+$'
        and relative_path !~ '^/'
        and relative_path !~ '^[A-Za-z]:'
        and relative_path !~ '\\'
        and relative_path !~ '(^|/)[[:space:]]*\.\.[[:space:]]*(/|$)'
        and relative_path !~ '(^|/)[[:space:]]*\.[[:space:]]*(/|$)'
        and relative_path !~ '(^|/)[[:space:]]'
        and relative_path !~ '[[:space:]](/|$)'
        and relative_path !~ '//'
        and relative_path !~ '/$'
        and relative_path !~ '%[0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f]'
        and relative_path !~ '(^|/)~'

asset_versions_loudness_unavailable_know.name: asset_versions_loudness_unavailable_known
asset_versions_loudness_unavailable_know.value: loudness_unavailable is null or loudness_unavailable in ('silent', 'too_short', 'unreadable')
